text:
maria: FYI kicked off a rehydrate for EU agg-hours (window 2026-03-12 00:00-06:00). counts look doubled vs expected, low-level logs show repeated ingest events. :confused:
raj: Which run id? link to the console job?
ops-bot: replay job started by maria - id rply-9832 - target: eu-agg-hours - mode: full_recompute - priority: normal - status: running
leo: If logs show repeated ingest events it could be a producer dup or we accidentally reingested a partition. Did we use dedupe=true for this replay?
maria: I didn't set dedupe explicitly, I used the quick CLI flow. Example I ran: `./replay run --target eu-agg-hours --from 2026-03-12T00:00 --to 2026-03-12T06:00`
sophia: Quick CLI defaults to dedupe=false for speed. For full recomputes we usually set `--dedupe true`. That explains duplicates.
raj: Oof. Running full recompute with duplicates will double-count aggregates. Can we cancel and restart with dedupe? What's the cancellation window?
leo: We can cancel the in-flight job but we need to be careful: partial writes may leave shard markers. Best to pause writes then run targeted idempotent stitch.
grace: Also note quota — a full restart will chew through backfill capacity and preempt user-facing routes. Suggest we do a canary: sample 10% of shards + shard_filter on the impacted tenancy to validate dedupe path.
maria: Agree. I'd rather run a sparse-window canary. If we expose `sample_rate` in the internal replay API we can test quickly. Current API doesn't accept sample_rate, it only supports `shard_ids` manually.
raj: We should add `sample_rate` and `skip_writes` flags to the internal endpoint. UX needs: console toggle for "canary sample" and a visible badge that marks metrics as 'canary' to avoid alert noise.
sophia: On console UX: add a warning modal when running any non-dedupe full recompute - it's too easy to shoot counts up. The modal should require `--dedupe` checkbox for >= 1h windows.
leo: For immediate triage: can we (1) pause the current job writes, (2) spawn a canary run with `sample_rate=0.1` + `dedupe=true` scoped to the same time window, (3) compare per-shard diffs?
maria: I'm pausing writes now. ran: `./replay update rply-9832 --writes disabled` — confirmed state: writes paused.
ops-bot: rply-9832 writes disabled by maria - job continues in read-only compute mode.
raj: I'll open an ops run that spins up the canary: internal API call snippet: ```
POST /internal/replay
{
  "target": "eu-agg-hours",
  "from": "2026-03-12T00:00",
  "to": "2026-03-12T06:00",
  "sample_rate": 0.1,
  "dedupe": true,
  "priority": "canary"
}
```
grace: Ensure we route canary traffic to a low-cost spot pool with isolated tokens so it doesn't hit Dedicated or preempt infra. Also add quota cap: `max_tokens: 200k` in the job proto.
sophia: I'll file a quick console UX ticket to expose `sample_rate` and the dedupe toggle, plus a badge `canary`/`dry-run` so dashboard panels can filter it out. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/console/pull/8712 (WIP)
maria: Perfect — once canary completes we'll diff `canary_output -> production` sample and make a call. If canary resolves duplicates then we cancel rply-9832 and restart with `dedupe=true` full run.
leo: Also need a small telemetry shim: when canary runs, tag outputs with `meta.recompute_tag = "canary-5054321000"` so dashboards can ignore or visually flag.
raj: I'll add the tag to the replay proto in the internal API. Minimal change.
maria: Action items: (1) raj start canary API call (in flight), (2) leo add shim to tag outputs, (3) sophia create console UX PR, (4) grace allocate spot pool + quota cap. I'll monitor diffs and post results here.
deploybot: canary deployment triggered for replay-api: feature/canary-sampling -> canary cluster - status: started :rocket:
leo: Small note — we should also add a guard in the replay CLI that warns if dedupe is false and window > 30m. Prevents accidental large non-dedupe runs. I'll sketch an RFC.
maria: Thanks everyone. Posting initial canary metrics in ~5m. :eyes:
raj: :thumbsup:
grace: :heart:
